wins.text: Q2 revenue surpassed $1B for the first time, growing 48% YoY and 14% sequentially to $1.004B, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by nearly 1,000 basis points
U.S. commercial revenue grew 93% YoY and 20% sequentially to $306M; U.S. commercial TCV booked hit a record $843M, up 222% YoY
Adjusted operating margin expanded to 46%, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by ~300 bps; Rule of 40 score reached 94%, up 11 points QoQ and the highest ever recorded
Record TCV of $2.3B and ACV of $684M in Q2; 157 deals worth $1M+, including 42 deals worth $10M+; top 20 customers averaging $75M in trailing 12-month revenue, up 30% YoY
Adjusted free cash flow of $569M in Q2 (57% margin); full-year adjusted FCF guidance raised to $1.8B–$2.0B; ended quarter with $6B in cash and equivalents

risks.text: International commercial revenue declined 3% YoY to $144M, with management explicitly deprioritizing international commercial in favor of U.S. acceleration
Revenue from strategic commercial contracts declining sharply — expected to be $2M–$4M in Q3 2025 vs. $10M in Q3 2024, and less than 0.5% of full-year revenue
Significant ramp in expenses expected in Q3 due to seasonality of new hire starts, which could pressure near-term margins despite full-year expansion commitment

Heavy customer concentration risk: top 20 customers represent a disproportionate share of revenue at $75M average trailing 12-month revenue each, and net dollar retention of 128% does not yet capture the full acceleration from new customers added in the past 12 months
U.S. government growth (53% YoY), while strong, is described as 'downstream from general trends in AI,' implying dependency on continued government AI spending priorities and policy continuity

guidance_items.detail: Q3 2025 revenue guided to $1.083B–$1.087B (50% YoY growth, 8%+ QoQ); full-year 2025 raised to $4.142B–$4.150B (45% YoY), a 9-point increase over prior guidance and largest-ever full-year raise
Full-year U.S. commercial revenue raised to excess of $1.302B (at least 85% growth), up 17 points from prior guidance
Full-year adjusted income from operations raised to $1.912B–$1.920B; Q3 adjusted income from operations guided to $493M–$497M
Full-year adjusted free cash flow raised to $1.8B–$2.0B; full-year Rule of 40 score guided to 91%; GAAP operating and net income expected in every quarter of 2025
